text:
By Trey Daubert ,
6 hours ago The running back notes are fresh out of the oven. Check out everything you need to know from the 2026 NFL Scouting Combine inside the article! (Consigliere) 2026 NFL Scouting Combine: Running Back Notes We’re officially onto day three for the 2026 NFL Scouting Combine. We pick things up with the running back, and… we have lots to talk about.
This group isn’t nearly as deep as it was last year, but there is still a fair bit of talent within the group. This is also probably my favorite group to watch every year because the knee bend and instincts that are displayed seem to project forward on the money every single year. If you revisit my previous years’ articles at this position, the receipts do not lie.
With that said, let’s get right down to business and talk about these RB notes from the 2026 NFL Scouting Combine!
Kaytron Allen (Penn State)
NFL Draft Stock Report: 2025 Week 1 , Week 6 , Week 7 , Week 9 , Week 10 , Week 13 , Conference Championship , Fiesta Bowl , Week 1 , Week 10 , Senior Bowl Day One , Day Two , Day Three
Measurables: Height (5-11), Weight (216), Arm Length (29 ½), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (9 ½)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash ( N/A ), 10-Yard Split ( N/A ), Vertical Jump ( N/A ), Broad Jump ( N/A ), 3-Cone ( N/A ), 20-Yard Shuffle ( N/A ), Bench ( N/A )
Did not run. Cuts were really, really nice in the first drill. Shakes the hips well. No turd mode. Has foot quickness.
His cuts are really nice. For a big back, there’s serious wiggle there. Looks really good. Same thing on the second rep.
Kinda hesitation in the Texas route, but that’s not really his game either.
I’m cool with his cuts. For a back with his style, they’re going to play, no question about it.
Wish he would have run, but loved what I saw. Got what I expected. Guy can flat out play, and he’s not small.
Max Bredeson (Michigan)
NFL Draft Stock Report: N/A
Measurables: Height (6-2), Weight (252), Arm Length (30 ⅛), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (10)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash ( N/A ), 10-Yard Split ( N/A ), Vertical Jump ( N/A ), Broad Jump ( N/A ), 3-Cone ( N/A ), 20-Yard Shuffle ( N/A ), Bench ( N/A )
Did not work out. Don’t get it cause why invite a fullback if he’s going to sit out?
Demond Claiborne (Wake Forest)
NFL Draft Stock Report: Week 3 , Duke’s Mayo Bowl , East-West Shrine Bowl Day One , Day Two
Measurables: Height (5-9 ¾), Weight (188), Arm Length (30 ⅛), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (9)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash (4.37), 10-Yard Split (1.59), Vertical Jump (N/A), Broad Jump (10-2), 3-Cone (N/A), 20-Yard Shuffle (N/A), Bench (N/A)
Fast run time. Fast. Almost jumped into the first cut, but looks good.
There’s real twitch on his cuts. Second drill, the shake was serious.
Solid in the Texas drill. Not freaky, but solid and catching it well.
Has a spark and that extra gear. Real burst. This is a real player.
Shut it down once the flat routes came out. I see the hype. I’m not sure how real it is, but it’s not like he’s a bad athlete. That part is obvious.
Jonah Coleman (Washington)
NFL Draft Stock Report: Week 7 , Week 8 , Week 14
Measurables: Height (5-8), Weight (220), Arm Length (28 ⅞), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (9 ⅛)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash ( N/A ), 10-Yard Split ( N/A ), Vertical Jump ( N/A ), Broad Jump ( N/A ), 3-Cone ( N/A ), 20-Yard Shuffle ( N/A ), Bench (22)
Did not work out. Only benched. Going to be a Stevenson clone.
CJ Donaldson (Ohio State)
NFL Draft Stock Report: 2025 Week 1 , 2026 Week 1 , Week 7 , Week 10 , Week 13 , East-West Shrine Bowl Day One , Day Two , Day Three , Game Notes , Practice Awards , Player Interview
Measurables: Height (6-2), Weight (230), Arm Length (31 ¾), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (9 ½)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash ( N/A ), 10-Yard Split ( N/A ), Vertical Jump ( N/A ), Broad Jump ( N/A ), 3-Cone ( N/A ), 20-Yard Shuffle ( N/A ), Bench ( N/A )
Did not run. Weak cuts. So so play speed going through the bags.
Second cut, there was at least emphasis on it, but no real spark.
Looks kinda slow on the dump off attempt. Texas route was okay, but play speed is not great.
Fell over in the next drill after the Texas route. His play speed is just brutal too. He looks way worse than at the Shrine Bowl. Borderline turd mode. Thought he was pretty terrible the entire day.
Rahsul Faison (South Carolina)
NFL Draft Stock Report: Week 1 , Week 4 , Week 7 , Week 9 , Week 12 , Senior Bowl Day One , Day Two , Day Three , Game Notes
Measurables: Height (5-10), Weight (208), Arm Length (30 ⅞), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (9)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash (N/A), 10-Yard Split ( N/A ), Vertical Jump (37.5), Broad Jump (10-2), 3-Cone ( N/A ), 20-Yard Shuffle ( N/A ), Bench ( N/A )
Did not run. First drill was stinky. Cuts were late. Second one, he almost ran into the bag. Play speed is mediocre.
Second drill was horrific. Guy literally had to stop, pause, then jump cut WAY late. Send this bum home already.
Texas route not good either. Just send this bum home. Nothing else to say. His spark is dead.
The guy can’t play a lick.
Eli Heidenreich (Navy)
NFL Draft Stock Report: East-West Shrine Day Two
Measurables: Height (6-0), Weight (198), Arm Length (29 ¼), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (9 ½)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash (4.44), 10-Yard Split (1.55), Vertical Jump (35.5), Broad Jump (10-0), 3-Cone (N/A), 20-Yard Shuffle (N/A), Bench (16)
Cuts were alright. Can do it, but not high level.
Dude ate it on the second drill. Fell completely over. He’s not totally with it, but not a terrible athlete. Made him redo it after falling over. Was late on the second attempt.
Sank his hips pretty well in the Texas route. Looks comfortable doing the pass game stuff. Way better in the passing game stuff. Passing game is way better as the day goes on.
Roman Hemby (Indiana)
NFL Draft Stock Report: Week 7 , Week 9 , Conference Championships , College Football Playoff Quarterfinals , College Football Playoff Semi-Finals , National Championship , East-West Shrine Day Two
Measurables: Height (6-0), Weight (207), Arm Length (31), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand ( 9 ½ )
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash ( N/A ), 10-Yard Split ( N/A ), Vertical Jump ( N/A ), Broad Jump ( N/A ), 3-Cone ( N/A ), 20-Yard Shuffle ( N/A ), Bench ( N/A )
Did not run. Pure feet are alright. Cuts looked good on the first bag drill.
Doesn’t look crazy dynamic, but his cuts are working it.
Bit high in the Texas route. Feet are decently quick, though. Catching the ball well.
Robert Henry Jr. (UTSA)
NFL Draft Stock Report: Week 1 , East-West Shrine Day Three , Practice Awards
Measurables: Height (5-9 ¼), Weight (196), Arm Length (30 ⅛), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (9 ⅛)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash (4.52), 10-Yard Split (1.62), Vertical Jump (37), Broad Jump (10-4), 3-Cone (N/A), 20-Yard Shuffle (4.31), Bench (N/A)
Cuts were fine. Just fine. Ran acceptable number.
Second drill, more of the same. Everything just kinda polished. Not crazy, but doing the job.
Kinda figuring this one out. Texas route more of the same. Can do it. Not blowing me away, but looks real. Does have real pivots. He’s passing the test.
Emmett Johnson (Nebraska)
NFL Draft Stock Report: Week 1 , Week 4 , Week 14
Measurables: Height (5-10 ¼), Weight (202), Arm Length (30 ¼), Wingspan (74 ⅜) , Hand (9 ⅝)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash (4.59), 10-Yard Split (1.59), Vertical Jump (35.5), Broad Jump (10-0), 3-Cone (7.32), 20-Yard Shuffle (4.29), Bench (16)
Ran slow time. First cut on the first drill, the guy almost fell over. Kinda tweaking while doing his cuts, not smooth.
Not loving what I’m seeing. Late on the second drill as well.
Feels late on everything. Even the Texas route, his head is looking back for the ball before just executing. Not sure he trusts his eyes or feet. Takes extra gathers than necessary. Too late on all this stuff. He doesn’t trust it. It’s so obvious.
Jeremiyah Love (Notre Dame)
NFL Draft Stock Report: 2025 CFB Playoff First Round , Sugar Bowl , Orange Bowl , National Championship , 2026 Week 1 , Week 3 , Week 5 , Week 8 , Week 12 , Week 13 , Week 14
Measurables: Height (6-0), Weight (212), Arm Length (32), Wingspan (78 ⅝) , Hand (9 ⅛)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash (4.36), 10-Yard Split (1.55), Vertical Jump (N/A), Broad Jump ( N/A ), 3-Cone ( N/A ), 20-Yard Shuffle ( N/A ), Bench ( N/A )
This is what an elite back looks like. Fast and his cuts were dynamic. Quick feet and his cuts covered serious ground.
More of the same. Second drill, OMG, the space he creates on these cuts is absurd.
He might be borderline freaky. The way he bends and breaks on this Texas route is fantastic. Different bread from the rest of the group, it’s so obvious. He’s totally blowing up in a good way. CRUSHING everything. I’d argue this might be the best RB drill I’ve seen. Even the wheel route was wow.
I’m not joking when I say this. I think this was maybe the best RB workout I’ve seen at this event. Christian McCaffrey being the former clubhouse leader. My early comp here is going to be Adrian Peterson – ish.
Seth McGowan (Kentucky)
NFL Draft Stock Report: Week 2 , Week 6 , Senior Bowl Day One , Day Two , Day Three , Game Notes
Measurables: Height (6-0 ¼), Weight (223), Arm Length (31 ¾), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (8 ¾)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash (4.49), 10-Yard Split (1.60), Vertical Jump (42.5), Broad Jump (10-11), 3-Cone (N/A), 20-Yard Shuffle (4.50), Bench (N/A)
Kinda decent. Bit late on the cut, but they had some movement to them.
Kinda a tweaker. Not sure what he’s going for on these cuts.
Decent Texas route. Looks good in passing game stuff. Although it’s more head bobble than actual skill. He looks like he’s shaking more than he really is.
Serious leaps.
Jam Miller (Alabama)
NFL Draft Stock Report: 2024 Week 7 , Conference Championship , 2025 Week 3 , Week 6 , Week 7 , Week 8 , Week 14 , ReliaQuest Bowl , 2026 Week 1 , Week 3 , Week 5 , Week 6 , Week 7 , Week 8 , Week 9 , Week 11 , Week 12 , Conference Championships , College Football Playoff First Round ,
Measurables: Height (5-10 ¼), Weight (209), Arm Length (30 ⅜), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (8 ¾)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash (4.42), 10-Yard Split (1.53), Vertical Jump (30.5), Broad Jump (9-7), 3-Cone (N/A), 20-Yard Shuffle (N/A), Bench (N/A)
Ran faster than I thought. Leaps not good. Cuts were pretty decent on the first rep.
Actually looks athletic. Kinda wrote him off at Bama, but he’s performing well.
Texas route was ok. He’s still doing way better than I thought he would overall. Not quite as good in passing game had a drop.
He was so bad this year at Bama. I’m not saying he was bad today, but I needed a tick more to move the needle I already had him at.
Le’Veon Moss (Texas A&M)
NFL Draft Stock Report: 2025 Week 1 , Week 3 , Week 6 , Week 9 , Week 10 , 2026 Week 1 , Week 3 , Week 5 , Week 6 , Week 7 , Week 8 , Week 9 , Week 11 , Week 12 , Week 14 , College Football Playoff First Round
Measurables: Height (5-11), Weight (203), Arm Length (31), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (9 ½)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash ( N/A ), 10-Yard Split ( N/A ), Vertical Jump ( N/A ), Broad Jump ( N/A ), 3-Cone ( N/A ), 20-Yard Shuffle ( N/A ), Bench ( N/A )
Did not work out. Dude is always hurt. The stock notes include extra links and don’t feel like adding more work to dig through the weeks he was hurt, where that was the only mention of him. Just know that going in. I have no time to spare, so thank you for your understanding.
Jadarian Price (Notre Dame)
NFL Draft Stock Report: 2025 National Championship , 2026 Week 1 , Week 3 , Week 5 , Week 8 , Week 13
Measurables: Height (5-10 ⅝), Weight (203), Arm Length (30 ⅞), Wingspan (76 ½) , Hand (9 ⅝)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash (4.49), 10-Yard Split (1.61), Vertical Jump ( 35 ), Broad Jump (10-4), 3-Cone (N/A), 20-Yard Shuffle (N/A), Bench (21)
Really nice cuts. Burst looks just fine, but the cuts were nice.
Kinda smooth. More smooth than twitch, but he’s performing well.
Lost footing on the Texas route, but he is catching the ball. More smooth than explosive. The pure feet are nice.
Overall, pretty good. He will pan out into something. Ceiling that part is still in question.
Adam Randall (Clemson)
NFL Draft Stock Report: Week 1 , Week 4 , Week 6 , Week 12 , Week 14 , Senior Bowl Day One , Day Two , Day Three , Game Notes
Measurables: Height (6-3 ⅜), Weight (232), Arm Length (32 ⅜), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (9 ⅝)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash (4.50), 10-Yard Split (1.60), Vertical Jump (37), Broad Jump (10-4), 3-Cone (N/A), 20-Yard Shuffle (4.53), Bench (26)
Guy stinks. Feet aren’t quick. Very late on the second cut, needing way too much time to gather.
Just straight up bad. Second drill had to really decelerate, then make up his mind. Doesn’t look like he has any instincts for this position.
Former receiver, guy should be ashamed. Even his Texas route, he’s dirt slow on the breaks. Routes are below average. The way he has to gear down is so gross.
Should be sent home. Total waste of time.
Desmond Reid (Pittsburgh)
NFL Draft Stock Report: 2025 Week 9 , Week 12 , GameAbove Bowl , 2026 Week 12
Measurables: Height (5-6), Weight (174), Arm Length (28 ⅛), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (8 ¼)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash ( N/A ), 10-Yard Split ( N/A ), Vertical Jump ( N/A ), Broad Jump ( N/A ), 3-Cone ( N/A ), 20-Yard Shuffle ( N/A ), Bench ( N/A )
Did not work out, which is a joke given his size. Small and not participating? WTF are we doing here man.
Nicholas Singleton (Penn State)
NFL Draft Stock Report: 2024 Week 3 , 2025 Week 1 , Week 6 , Week 7 , Week 9 , Week 10 , Week 13 , Conference Championship , Fiesta Bowl , Week 1 , Week 5 , Week 10 , Senior Bowl Day One , Day Two , Day Three
Measurables: Height (6-0), Weight (219), Arm Length (31), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (9 ⅜)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash ( N/A ), 10-Yard Split ( N/A ), Vertical Jump ( N/A ), Broad Jump ( N/A ), 3-Cone ( N/A ), 20-Yard Shuffle ( N/A ), Bench ( N/A )
Broken foot at Senior Bowl. Did not work out.
J’Mari Taylor (Virginia)
NFL Draft Stock Report: Senior Bowl Day One , Day Two , Day Three
Measurables: Height (5-10), Weight (199), Arm Length (30), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (9)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash (N/A), 10-Yard Split ( N/A ), Vertical Jump (34.5), Broad Jump (9-7), 3-Cone ( N/A ), 20-Yard Shuffle ( N/A ), Bench (20)
Did not run. Cuts were really bad. Late reaction time and not shifty at all.
Second cut was better. Definitely not a world beater though. Not quick enough on the Texas route. Just not dynamic at all.
Looks better catching the ball. He’s still rough in terms of having to decelerate and gear up. Couldn’t catch the wheel route.
Still a meh nothing talent.
Mike Washington Jr. (Arkansas)
NFL Draft Stock Report: Week 4 , Week 5 , Senior Bowl Day One , Day Two , Day Three , Game Notes
Measurables: Height (6-1), Weight (223), Arm Length (33 ⅝), Wingspan (82) , Hand (9 ¼)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash (4.33), 10-Yard Split (1.51), Vertical Jump (39), Broad Jump (10-8), 3-Cone (N/A), 20-Yard Shuffle (N/A), Bench (N/A)
Crazy run time. I’m not sure how I feel about him crying about it afterward, but whatever. Did not do drill work. Good leaps, but the crying and shutting it down is weird, man.
Noah Whittington (Oregon)
2025 , , , , 2026 , , , , , , , ,
Measurables: Height (5-8), Weight (205), Arm Length (29 ⅛), Wingspan (N/A) , Hand (8 ¼)
Athletic Testing: 40-Yard Dash (N/A), 10-Yard Split ( N/A ), Vertical Jump ( N/A ), Broad Jump ( N/A ), 3-Cone ( N/A ), 20-Yard Shuffle ( N/A ), Bench (24)
Did not work out. Got hurt in the playoff. Toe injury. Really nice bench number.
